items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Because he was around there playing at alto sound like a tenor before John Handy came, before Pops came.

ctx.x: Because he was around there playing at alto sound like a tenor before John Handy came, before Pops came. Because Pops was living over, John Handy was living over in Mississippi. That's where he came from. Yeah.
Oh, we didn't talk about Joe Oliver, King Oliver, when you got up, got up there with him. Uh, did he have trouble collecting this money ever, or was he making a lot of money?
